description: National Medicines Regulatory  Authority - Medicines (Pricing Mechanism for Medicines) Regulations Under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No.05 of 2015.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing a legal framework for medicine pricing mechanisms. It creates binding legal requirements, specifies formulas for price calculations, and outlines enforcement provisions, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than focusing on government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
